text:
sarah_sales: Quick FYI — Acme asks for CAIQ answers + evidence for POC: network encryption (in-transit), KMS ownership (BYOE option), and logging. They want artifacts by Thu EOD. Who owns what and what artifacts can we hand off? Also need price delta for BYOE. Ping if you can take lead.

jordan_se: I can own the technical mapping. Short answer: Redwood covers platform/host/network controls and TLS termination. Customer owns tenant data and key material if BYOE. I'll draft the control mapping and populate evidence slots.

deepa_security: Adding specifics: For CAIQ - network encryption in transit -> TLS 1.2+ enforced between client and our API; mTLS is available for Private deployments. Evidence = LB TLS policy export + cipher suites + cert rotation cadence. For KMS ownership: if BYOE, customer provides KMS policy snippets, rotation schedule, and attestation that key material never leaves their KMS. If Redwood-managed KMS, we provide rotation logs, ARN metadata, and HSM attest artifacts.

deepa_security: Template: https://redwood.infra/docs/caicq-evidence-template (internal) — fields to fill: evidence_type, control_id, owner, artifact_link, retention. :eyes:

navin_sre: For Dedicated/Private POCs we need a network diagram (subnets, peering/VPN, NACLs, security groups). For Hosted we can provide a redacted boundary diagram and controls summary. I can generate diagrams once we get customer CIDR and whether they want direct peering or VPN.

liam_ps: Pricing note: BYOE (customer-managed KMS) has no platform token surcharge, but we typically add a one-time POC support fee (~$1,000) to cover attestation and evidence prep. Dedicated/Private pricing as usual for reserved capacity. Confirm POC scale so I can produce a short quote.

sarah_sales: POC details: ~5k tokens/day, 2 devs, 2-week window. Customer will attempt BYOE but wants fallback to Redwood-managed KMS. Deadline Thu EOD for artifacts. Looping in legal for NDA and any required attestations.

jordan_se: Draft checklist below — I'll start populating; if you upload artifacts paste links here. :thumbsup:

```
- Control: Network Encryption (In Transit)
  owner: Redwood (platform)
  artifact: load-balancer-tls-config.pdf / lb-cipher-list.txt
- Control: KMS Ownership & Rotation
  owner: Customer (BYOE) OR Redwood (managed)
  artifact: customer-kms-policy.json OR redwood-kms-rotation.log
- Control: Audit & Logging
  owner: Redwood (platform) -> provide sample syslog/export and retention policy
  artifact: sample-logs.tar.gz / audit-retention.pdf
- Control: Network Boundary Diagram
  owner: Redwood/navin_sre (hosted = redacted diagram)
  artifact: acme-poc-network-diagram.pdf
```

deepa_security: I'll fill the KMS policy checklist and add rotation proof. Expect uploads to the internal evidence bucket by Wed; I'll tag them acme-poc and add artifact links here.

sarah_sales: Thanks all — assigning jordan_se as lead for the CAIQ mapping. @jordan_se please notify me when the first draft is ready so I can send to customer. @liam_ps need BYOE pricing quote by EOD tomorrow.
